body.name: graph-recursive root map
body.construction: For each selected real diagonal root \(A_{ii}\) of \(B_{ii}\), process pairs \((v,u)\) in increasing \(v-u\); when \(C_m(A_{vv},A_{uu})\ne0\), set \(A_{vu}=\{B_{vu}-R_{vu,m}(A)\}/C_m(A_{vv},A_{uu})\) on an allowed edge and set forbidden entries to zero subject to their induced compatibility equations.
